_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail on the pattern of the Paper egg (minecraft-paper.yaml): the jar from Pufferfish's Jenkins (ci.pufferfish.host, one job per Minecraft line) checked against a SHA-256 Octail recorded (Pufferfish publishes none) or one staff set in PUFFERFISH_SHA256, a version or build that does not exist fails the install, the eula flag (the panel asks the owner on the first start, nothing is pre-accepted), Java 25 to 17 images (Pufferfish's lines go back to 1.17), Minecraft Java idle sleep, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: Pufferfish
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Pufferfish is a performance fork of Paper for large servers. Runs Paper, Spigot and Bukkit plugins.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Pufferfish installation (Octail): the jar from Pufferfish's Jenkins (ci.pufferfish.host), one job per
# Minecraft line (Pufferfish-1.21 builds the newest 1.21.x; Pufferfish supports only that line). "latest"
# is the newest successful build of the 1.21 job; a version picks the newest successful build whose jar
# names it.
# Pufferfish publishes no checksum or signature, and its Jenkins records no fingerprints for the jars, so
# this script carries the SHA-256 of the builds Octail recorded (2026-10-13). Any other build needs its
# SHA-256 in the staff variable PUFFERFISH_SHA256, or the install fails. A version or build that doesn't
# exist fails the install.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu

CI=https://ci.pufferfish.host/job
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
BUILD="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"
STAFF_SHA256=$(echo "${PUFFERFISH_SHA256:-}" | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')

# <job> <build> <sha256>: builds Octail downloaded and checked (a paperclip jar naming its version).
PINNED='Pufferfish-1.21 39 2e5d8a27f62086948590dd8d7e36761f0c80a0dfb85820e34714d795ca3f99aa
Pufferfish-1.21 33 4dd5cc297217cc91aa85ee52a240f6df5a7b78eebc1f91d64652cabea3141f47'

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1"; }
# The Minecraft version a jar's name gives away: pufferfish-paperclip-1.21.10-R0.1-SNAPSHOT-mojmap.jar.
jar_version() { echo "$1" | sed -nE 's/^.*[Pp]ufferfish-(paperclip-)?([0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)-R0\.1.*\.jar$/\2/p'; }

if [ -n "${STAFF_SHA256}" ] && ! echo "${STAFF_SHA256}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'; then
	fail "PUFFERFISH_SHA256 must be 64 hex characters (a SHA-256) or empty"
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
	VERSION=latest
	LINE=1.21
else
	echo "${VERSION}" | grep -Eq '^1\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' || fail "the Minecraft version (${VERSION}) must be like 1.21.10, or latest"
	LINE=$(echo "${VERSION}" | cut -d . -f 1-2)
fi
JOB="${CI}/Pufferfish-${LINE}"
if [ "${LINE}" != "1.21" ]; then
	echo "Note: Pufferfish no longer supports ${LINE}; reported bugs are not fixed."
fi

if [ -z "${BUILD}" ] || [ "${BUILD}" = "latest" ]; then
	BUILDS=$(get "${JOB}/api/json?tree=builds%5Bnumber,result,artifacts%5BrelativePath%5D%5D") ||
		fail "can't reach Pufferfish's Jenkins, or it has no Minecraft ${LINE} job (${JOB})"
	BUILD=""
	for row in $(echo "${BUILDS}" | jq -r '.builds // [] | sort_by(.number) | reverse | .[] |
		select(.result == "SUCCESS") | "\(.number)|\([.artifacts[]?.relativePath | select(endswith(".jar"))] | first // "")"'); do
		path="${row#*|}"
		[ -n "${path}" ] || continue
		if [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ "$(jar_version "${path##*/}")" = "${VERSION}" ]; then
			BUILD="${row%%|*}"
			break
		fi
	done
	[ -n "${BUILD}" ] || fail "Pufferfish has no successful build for Minecraft ${VERSION}. Its builds are listed at https://pufferfish.host/downloads"
fi
case "${BUILD}" in
*[!0-9]*) fail "the build number (${BUILD}) must be a number or latest" ;;
esac

INFO=$(get "${JOB}/${BUILD}/api/json?tree=number,result,artifacts%5BrelativePath%5D") ||
	fail "Pufferfish's Jenkins has no build ${BUILD} for Minecraft ${LINE}"
RESULT=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.result // empty')
[ "${RESULT}" = "SUCCESS" ] || fail "Pufferfish build ${BUILD} did not succeed (${RESULT}). Pick another build."
ARTIFACT=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '[.artifacts[]?.relativePath | select(endswith(".jar"))] | first // empty')
echo "${ARTIFACT}" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\.jar$' || fail "Pufferfish build ${BUILD} has no server jar"
GOT_VERSION=$(jar_version "${ARTIFACT##*/}")
[ -n "${GOT_VERSION}" ] || fail "Pufferfish build ${BUILD}'s jar (${ARTIFACT##*/}) doesn't name its Minecraft version"
if [ "${VERSION}" != "latest" ] && [ "${GOT_VERSION}" != "${VERSION}" ]; then
	fail "Pufferfish build ${BUILD} is Minecraft ${GOT_VERSION}, not ${VERSION}"
fi

SHA256=$(echo "${PINNED}" | awk -v j="Pufferfish-${LINE}" -v b="${BUILD}" '$1 == j && $2 == b { print $3 }')
if [ -n "${STAFF_SHA256}" ]; then
	SHA256="${STAFF_SHA256}"
fi
[ -n "${SHA256}" ] ||
	fail "Pufferfish publishes no checksum, and Octail has none recorded for build ${BUILD} (Minecraft ${GOT_VERSION}). Staff can check that jar and set its SHA-256 in the egg's PUFFERFISH_SHA256 variable, or pick a recorded build (1.21 job: 39 for 1.21.10, 33 for 1.21.8)."

echo "Installing Pufferfish ${GOT_VERSION} build ${BUILD} as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "${JAR}.download" "${JOB}/${BUILD}/artifact/${ARTIFACT}" ||
	fail "the download of Pufferfish build ${BUILD} failed"
GOT=$(sha256sum "${JAR}.download" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SHA256}" ]; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "SHA-256 mismatch for Pufferfish build ${BUILD} (expected ${SHA256}, got ${GOT})"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"

echo "Pufferfish ${GOT_VERSION} build ${BUILD} installed (SHA-256 checked)."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version to install, such as 1.21.10, or latest for the newest build Pufferfish made (it supports one 1.21.x release at a time). Pufferfish builds one release per line (1.21.10, 1.20.4, 1.19.4, 1.18.2, 1.17.1); the older lines are unsupported.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 21 or 25 for 1.21.x, Java 17 for 1.17 to 1.20.4.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: The Pufferfish Jenkins build to install, or latest for the newest successful build of that Minecraft version. Builds without a recorded SHA-256 need staff to set one (PUFFERFISH_SHA256).

variables.name: Pufferfish SHA-256
variables.description: Pufferfish publishes no checksums. The install script carries the SHA-256 of the builds Octail checked (1.21 job: 39 for 1.21.10, 33 for 1.21.8); for any other build, download the jar from https://pufferfish.host/downloads, check it, and put its SHA-256 here. Empty: only the recorded builds install.
